actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed >10 in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity affordable (floor(2.82/0.3)=9) and broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 2.82, free rider threshold 10, so wallet <10, cannot rest? Actually rule: If wallet above threshold, rest. Wallet is below, so else if cannot rest (already at zero?) Not zero, but below threshold -> we can act. Check last round contributions: round 6 contributions: Resident2 contributed 10.43 (>10). So we must punish that resident with max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet 2.82, cost 0.3 => 2.82/0.3=9.4 floor 9. So severity 9. target Resident2. Also can broadcast warning. Choose at most one physical and one communication. So actions: punish Resident2 amount 9, broadcast warning. Explanation.
